mode: Read-only source review; root performed browser interaction tests separately.
checks: Fixed XPU 1/XPU 2/Admin pane mapping retains one compute worker and a separate explicit host capability.
Each pane form resolves its own record and passes an explicit target to sendCommand; administrator input does not depend on another pane focus.
XPU catalog actions explicitly select an XPU, preventing accidental host-shell dispatch.
Form input rejects C0/C1 controls; canvas paste becomes one editable line; raw terminal key input is bounded by its transport.
Closed/removed socket writes and Ctrl+C are guarded and errors handled.
Removing a pending Administrator pane immediately cancels AdminLink; an async open returning late is closed.
Removed-record onData/onClose callbacks cannot mutate a new session in reused pane DOM.
Reopening reserves the fixed slot and chooses its actual local/WebSocket worker session for delegation.

nonBlockingObservations.detail: Shared status polling can overwrite a closed active Administrator session disconnect reason with the generic Administrator label because it does not skip closed records or inspect connection state. Per-pane Closed state and input disabling remain correct.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedFix: Skip t.closed/t.removed in the shared status poll or render the returned connection value.
